notes: Modified cash basis county, governmental funds only (fiduciary funds skipped). Statement lines from the Total Governmental Funds column of Exhibit III (pp4-5, Total column p5); fund balances and Cash and Deposits from p7 (beginning cash not printed, so beginning_cash null; beginning fund balance 5,012,871). Roll-forward ties: 5,012,871 + 4,999,762 - 5,258,446 + 1,731,155 - 1,731,155 = 4,754,187. Debt Service 139,563 split into Principal Retirement 130,129 and Interest Payments 9,434 from the Road Fund schedule (p16). Balance sheet from the governmental funds statement (p7) because its total equals the Statement of Net Position (p1: Cash and Deposits 4,729,359 + Designated Deposits 24,828 = 4,754,187; Restricted 417,654, Unrestricted 4,336,533); Road 479,466 and Inheritance Tax 2,454,576 are in Assigned (Total column Assigned 3,592,113). Detail: Schedules 1-4 (pp8-20); Schedule 5 (fund balance changes, incl. fiduciary funds, pp21-22), Schedule 6 combined statement (pp23-24), Schedule 7 budget-and-actual by fund type (pp25-26) and Schedule 8 tax collections (p27) not recorded to avoid double counting. Schedule lines with a blank actual cell were skipped (e.g. General Fund Federal budget 3,000 and Transfers, Inheritance Tax operating/capital budgets, Highway Buyback capital outlay budget, Noxious Weed rental expense, Bowman Park operating/capital, several capital outlay budgets); printed zero actuals were kept. The Emergency Manager section total is printed as 'Total Diversion Program' 9,038 and the Board of Supervisors total as 'Total Board of Commissioners'. Transfers: in 1,731,155 = Road 1,657,703 + Noxious Weed 45,257 + Public Libraries 13,919 + Planning and Zoning 14,276; out = General 1,623,500 + Inheritance Tax 13,919 + Highway Buyback 93,736.
